log.msg: leaf-awareness fix: Tree.node_of() now treats a child with `leaf: true` (core/Page/readme.md) as having no deeper branch — `deeper = child && !child.leaf && (child.child_source || child.children?.size)` — so a root: tree draws it as a flat link, same as sections()-built pages: data always did. Also added `count: child?.children.size` on every node, the real child-count fix used below.

drop-then-click fix: Tree.Drag.release() now calls swallow_click() after end() — a capturing `click` listener on the tree's own root, added synchronously and removed on the next tick, stops the synthetic click the browser fires on the row right after a grip-drag's pointerup before it ever reaches the row's own bubble-phase click handler (tree.select()). Both real.js guards this replaces are in imagine/paging/make/doc/decisions.md section 5.

closed-branch-count fix: Tree.Drag.commit()'s "into" case now reads into.count (the live Page's real Map size, known synchronously even before the branch is opened) when into.children is still a function (unopened), instead of counting an empty array. Loaded/open branches are unchanged (still filter(n => n !== this.node).length).

item 1+2 verified via eval unit tests against the real Tree.Drag/Tree.node_of methods (no mocks of the fix itself): leaf child -> node.children undefined (was drawn as a branch before), count preserved at 2; branch child -> children is a function as before. Closed-branch commit(): index=3 (matches into.count), matching an already-open branch still excludes the dragged node from its own count (index=1). Drop-click swallow: the very next click on a row is stopped, a later click 30ms after is not - the fix does not eat unrelated clicks.

assign.outcome:
**Three real `ux/Tree` bugs fixed at the source, two `core/Sidebar` callers swapped to the live tree.** All three fixes are unit-verified against the real methods and, for the two that show up in the browser, proven live: a `leaf: true` page (`core/Page/readme.md`) no longer draws as an openable branch in a `root:` tree — verified on `/framework/`'s own sidebar, where **AI** and **UX** (both leaf pages) now draw with no expand caret while **Core** still opens to its real 10 children. A drop's own trailing click no longer re-selects the row (it used to cancel whatever question the drop had just raised — Make's confirm row was the case that found it). A drop into a closed branch now lands after its real children instead of before all of them. Make's two hand-rolled guards for these (`imagine/paging/make/real.js`) are deleted as dead code, verified by loading Make's real-pages tree clean afterward (0 console errors, 10 rows).

`framework/page.js` and `michael/page.js` now pass `root: this` instead of a flat `pages:` array — **13 rows before, 13 after** on `/framework/` (Core now reaches 10 real children instead of a flat 2-level group; `framework/page.js`'s now-dead `sections()` method is deleted), **10 rows before, 10 after** on `/michael/` (Elements now reaches its own 6 children). Both checked at 1280 and 3440.

Of 12 real `new Sidebar(...)` constructions site-wide, 11 still pass a flat list; 4 of those are inside `core/Sidebar/page.js` itself (out of this task's fence — another minion owns that module) and untouched. Of the 7 in-fence candidates, only these 2 had `pages:` data that actually came from `this.children` — the other 5 build their sidebar from a hardcoded list or a different page's data entirely, so `root: this` would have shown zero rows, a real regression, not a same-first-level swap: left alone, with the reason logged for each.

Docs: one dated section in `ux/Tree/doc/decisions.md` covering all three fixes; the stale leaf caveat in `core/Sidebar/readme.md` updated to point at the fix instead of the gap.
